issue.title: test_resolve_agent_page_url_refreshes_after_snapshot_ttl fails under the full parallel lane, passes serially
issue.description:
REPRODUCTION: proposed by phase bead sase-n9.3 (epic sase-n9) as a PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP on 2026-08-16T17:54Z and relayed by sase-n9.land. During that phase's 'just check', the escalated parallel test lane failed tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_agent_page_url.py::test_resolve_agent_page_url_refreshes_after_snapshot_ttl (together with the separately tracked tests/ace/tui/test_config_center_state.py::test_save_atomically_replaces_existing_state, see sase-md). Both passed on a serial re-run with '-p no:xdist' and that phase's diff still applied, so the failure is parallel-lane-only. Confirmed again during sase-n9 landing at HEAD a892dce3a: '.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_agent_page_url.py::test_resolve_agent_page_url_refreshes_after_snapshot_ttl' passes standalone.

IMPACT: an unrelated agent cannot get a clean full-suite 'just check', which is what deferred sase-n9.3's verification onto the epic's land agent.

SCOPE: the node exercises the snapshot-TTL cache that task sase-lw added to resolve_agent_page_url (a process-global memo keyed on a snapshot token). Reproduce under the parallel lane, identify which other test leaves that cache warm or perturbs its TTL/token, and isolate the global cache around this test (or make the TTL assertion robust) rather than weakening the refresh assertion. Root cause is distinct from sase-mv/sase-md, which are the config-cache and config-center-state variants of the same process-global-leak class.

payload.entry: RELATED: sase-md — the other node from the same sase-n9.3 full-lane run; same pass-in-isolation shape, different process-global cache (ACE config-center state persistence).
RELATED: sase-lw — added the resolve_agent_page_url snapshot-TTL cache this test pins; its cache is the process-global state most likely being poisoned.
RELATED: sase-j7 — in-progress epic owning the 'process-global state leaking between tests' flake class at its root; this node is a member of that class but was not in sase-j7's inventory.
